subject: Introduction - I now handle Kessler Tooling's receivables
text:
Dear Accounts Payable team,

My name is Elena Markovic and I recently joined Kessler Tooling as their external accountant, replacing Mr. Kessler who used to send you our invoices. I am updating the payment records of all clients. Please process payments for Kessler Tooling through my firm's client trust account:

Kessler Partners Client Trust
Routing 071000013
Account 1004 2231 90

Mr. Kessler is traveling and unreachable, so please reply to me directly.
label: change_request
note: Claimed new accountant redirecting to a third party's trust account, with an excuse why the real contact is unreachable.
